sessionLogs.title: Session 1: The Triboar Ambush
sessionLogs.summary: Hired by Gundren Rockseeker in Neverwinter to escort supplies to Phandalin. Tracked ambushing goblins to Cragmaw Hideout, struck a deal with Yeemik, defeated Klarg, and rescued Sildar Hallwinter.
sessionLogs.content:
DM Notes:
- Hired by Gundren Rockseeker in Neverwinter to escort supplies to Phandalin
- Discovered signs of an ambush on the Triboar Trail and were attacked by goblins
- Captured a goblin and learned of a nearby hideout
- Tracked the goblins to Cragmaw Hideout
- Released the wolves held in Cragmaw Hideout
- Struck a deal with Yeemik to defeat Klarg in exchange for Sildar’s safety
- Defeated Klarg and rescued Sildar Hallwinter
- Chose to leave remaining goblins and withdraw

sessionLogs.title: Session 2: Trouble in Phandalin & The Redbrand Hideout
sessionLogs.summary: Arrived in Phandalin. Scouted Tresendar Manor, infiltrated the Redbrand Hideout, freed prisoners, and captured the wizard Glasstaff.
sessionLogs.content:
DM Notes:
- Arrived in Phandalin
- Sildar told of Gundren seeking Wave Echo Cave
- Delivered supplies to Barthen, Redbrands took tax
- Attempted to talk to strange spider which then ran away
- Visited Shrine of Luck, did not receive good luck from Garaele
- Garaele mentioned Agatha can answer a question for those brave enough to face her, near Conyberry
- Visited weapons shop. Received Redbrand cloaks from Halia and promise of reward if they kill the leader Glasstaff
- Visited Inn. Briefly met with Sildar
- Scouted Sleeping Giant taphouse, decided not to engage
- Scouted Tresendar Manor and found Redbrand Hideout in cellar
- Freed prisoners in the hideout, including the deceased sheriff’s family and the halfling Darrin Copperpot who claims to have found a box the Redbrands took
- Fully scouted the hideout with familiars
- Surprised Glasstaff and took him down as he attempted to flee
